properties.name: Hayhurst to Rieke shift area (Scenarios A and B)
properties.description: Hayhurst's southeast panhandle moved to Rieke in Scenarios A/B: SW Vermont St / SW Capitol Hwy (north), SW 25th Ave (east), SW Capitol Hwy (west), SW Troy St (south). Matches the status-quo vs A/B maps in sources/pps_net/rightsizing/school_impact/hayhurst.pdf p.4 and rieke.pdf p.4.
properties.method: Vertices taken from Portland Maps street centerlines (Public/Street_Centerlines layer 0) for SW Capitol Hwy, SW Vermont St, SW Troy St and SW 25th Ave; SW Capitol Hwy runs on the Vermont alignment between SW 25th and ~SW 29th. Drawn 2026-10-22.
